en.title: England Women Beat USA 55-12 in WXV Global Series
en.dek: England's Red Roses win 55-12 over the United States in New Jersey, extending their winning streak.
facts: England scored 55 points while the United States scored 12.
England scored nine tries, including four by Claudia Moloney‑MacDonald.
The United States scored two tries, one by Hope Rogers and one by Kate Zackary.
The match took place on 30 October 2026 in New Jersey.
England had lost two consecutive tests to Canada before this victory.
body: England’s Red Roses returned to winning ways after two losses to Canada, according to Sky Sports and BBC Sport. The match ended 55-12 in England’s favour, with England scoring nine tries and the United States two.

Claudia Moloney‑MacDonald scored four tries, while Meg Jones, Mia Venner, Bryony Field, Maddie Feaunati and Sadia Kabeya added one each. The United States’ tries were scored by Hope Rogers and Kate Zackary, with the latter diving over in the final minutes.

The game was played on 30 October 2026 in New Jersey, as reported by both outlets. England had lost 69‑7 to the United States in the opening match of their World Cup campaign last year, according to Sky Sports.
Head coach John Mitchell noted that the win will give him material to consider before the Women’s Six Nations title defence in April, according to BBC Sport.
en.context: The WXV Global Series is a women's rugby competition featuring national teams from around the world. England had suffered two consecutive defeats to Canada before this match.
